label: D1 after a rewarded a2 trial (reward streak), early episode, moderate a2 preference
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (93% of mass) when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass has prev_reward == 1), after the agent chose a2 on the previous trial (only ~2% of mass after a1), and the trial before that was also rewarded (requiring this removes many false positives and loses no recall). It is confined to the first ~30 trials of an episode (almost nothing after trial 50) and mostly in episodes where S2 is good, with the policy logit at a moderate a2 preference (choice in [-4.44, -1.52]) and value in a narrow 7.5-7.7 band. So it reads as an early-episode reward-streak-on-a2 signal at D1. It never fires at GO. A small D2 component (7% of mass) includes the top activations, on trials where the agent switched to a1 in an a2/S2 context; this is not captured. Predicates use only observed variables plus the model own policy logit; adding the episode-trial and choice-band conditions is needed for precision, which stays around 0.45, because many matching steps are silent. Activations are tiny (max 0.005), and I did not check what modulates magnitude beyond the quartile coverage, which is flat.
